This document out lines the details equipment inspection steps I1, required 
for GR FAN (this fan is used for increasing reheater temperaturen). This inspection 
performed every 1.6 month as indicated by M1 & M6 in the above title block.

The 
first draft initiated by eng: Abdalla M. Abdalla. reviewed by directed by 
eng: Gamal Arafa and revised by quality control eng. Samir Abd el-Gelil at edec, 
accepted by general director eng. M. Abd el-salam and approved by eng: Michael 
Goerge: head sector of Ayoun Moussa Steam Power Station 2x320 MW

items:
A work 
 permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category

Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area,
Wear your safety helmet, shoes ... etc

Isolate the circuit breaker for the motor of this 
 GR FAN

Isolate the electrical cable feeding of the motor 
 of this GR FAN

The GR FAN must be isolated mechanically by 
 closing suction and delivery valve
Cleaning fluid, Manual puller,
Suitable lifting device. Feeler gauge

Hammer,
 Dial indicator,
 Tourqe wrench

Check the bearing oil level and 
 adjuste as required

Check the main bearing temperature. refer to start - stop sequence for alarm 
 and trip temp
Check the bearing cooling water flow
Check the lube oil lins for oil line leakage
Check the fan for smooth operation

Check all anchor bolts and support steel fasteners bolts, and tighten if 
 necessary
Check the bearing oil for contamination
Check the fan blades for waer

Examine rotor and blade liners for any signs of erosion and remove all traces 
 of deposit before carrying out this examination. Should there be evidence of 
 severe abrasion, If there isn`t any severe abrasion, and the rotor is to be 
 used again without repairs, check for fan balance.
Examine fan housing and inlet box for signs of wear.
Body bound bolts of rotor inner plate/shaft connection for wear
Examine damper assemblies for waer of blades and blade spindles

Examine bearings and couplings and make adjustments or replacements where 
 necessary. Give particular attention to bearing seals

Check position of rotor in fan housing relative to the inlet cone. Make 
 adjustments where necessary. Check shaft seals at inlet box
Check shaft seals at inlet box

Tighten all hold down bolts in fan housing, sole plates, bearings, and base 
 frames.
Check coupling alignment

Introduction

Technical Specification of GR FAN
Item | GR FAN
No. of GR FAN | 4
Type of GR FAN | Centrifugal
Manufacture | T.L.T
Capacity m 3/s | 85.3
Static pressure kpa | 2.06
Fluid | Flue gases
R.P.M | 1000
Bearing type | Sleeve baring
Bearing size | 37/16 inch
Type of recommended oil | Mobil D.T.E. heavy ISO VG 100
Motor power kw | 460

Examine bearings and couplings and make adjustments or replacements where

Check position of rotor in fan housing relative to the inlet cone. Make

Check shaft seals at inlet box

Check coupling alignment
